title: Functoriality of the plus construction
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ let $\mathcal F^+$, the classes $[\mathcal U,s]$ ($\mathcal U$ a covering of $U$, $s\in H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$) and $\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^+$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of presheaves of sets. Then: (a) the rule $\varphi^+_U([\mathcal U,(s_i)_i])=[\mathcal U,(\varphi_{U_i}(s_i))_i]$ gives a well-defined map $\varphi^+_U:\mathcal F^+(U)\to\mathcal G^+(U)$ for every object $U$, and these maps form a morphism of presheaves $\varphi^+:\mathcal F^+\to\mathcal G^+$; (b) $\theta_{\mathcal G}\circ\varphi=\varphi^+\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}$; (c) $(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F})^+=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F^+}$ and $(\psi\circ\varphi)^+=\psi^+\circ\varphi^+$ for a second morphism $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$. In other words $\mathcal F\mapsto(\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^+)$ is a functor and $\theta$ is a natural transformation from the identity to it.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00W5 (lemma-plus-functorial), whose proof in the source only states the square to be checked; the map on $H^0$ is the evident one of Section 00W1

proof.text: For a covering $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ and $s=(s_i)_i\in H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$, define $\varphi^+_{\mathcal U}(s)=(\varphi_{U_i}(s_i))_i$. This family lies in $H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal G)$: on each $U_i\times_UU_j$, the two restrictions of $s_i$ and $s_j$ agree, and applying the naturality square for the presheaf morphism $\varphi$ preserves that equality. If $f: \mathcal U'\to\mathcal U$ is a refinement over $\mathrm{id}_U$, then $f^*(\varphi^+_{\mathcal U}s)=\varphi^+_{\mathcal U'}(f^*s)$ componentwise, since both sides restrict $\varphi_{U_{\alpha(i')}}(s_{\alpha(i')})$ along the same component map.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00W5 (lemma-plus-functorial), with the map on compatible H^0 families induced componentwise

proof.text: The refinement compatibility in step 1 makes the componentwise maps a morphism of the two colimit diagrams $H^0(-,\mathcal F)$ and $H^0(-,\mathcal G)$ on $\mathcal J_U^{\mathrm{opp}}$. Hence the universal property of the colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] gives a unique map $\varphi^+_U:\mathcal F^+(U)\to\mathcal G^+(U)$ with $\varphi^+_U([\mathcal U,s])=[\mathcal U,\varphi^+_{\mathcal U}(s)]$. For $h:V\to U$, use the fibre-product covering and its projection refinement from [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. The componentwise identity after pulling back along $h$ shows $\mathcal G^+(h)\circ\varphi^+_U=\varphi^+_V\circ\mathcal F^+(h)$ on colimit representatives, so the maps $\varphi^+_U$ form a morphism of presheaves.

source.place: Sites, Section 00W1 and Lemma 00W5: refinement compatibility descends to colimits and commutes with restriction maps

proof.text: For $a\in\mathcal F(U)$, the canonical map sends $a$ to the class of the compatible family $(a|_{U_i})_i$ on the trivial covering. Applying the componentwise rule gives the class of $(\varphi_{U_i}(a|_{U_i}))_i=(\varphi_U(a)|_{U_i})_i$, by the presheaf naturality square. This is exactly $\theta_{\mathcal G,U}(\varphi_U(a))$, proving $\theta_{\mathcal G}\circ\varphi=\varphi^+\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}$.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00W5 (lemma-plus-functorial), the naturality square for the canonical map to the plus construction

proof.text: On every representative $[\mathcal U,s]$, the map induced by $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F}$ leaves each component unchanged, so $(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F})^+=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F^+}$. For $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\varphi}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\psi}\mathcal H$, applying the construction twice sends $(s_i)_i$ to $(\psi_{U_i}(\varphi_{U_i}(s_i)))_i$, which is the componentwise image under $\psi\circ\varphi$; equality on all colimit representatives gives $(\psi\circ\varphi)^+=\psi^+\circ\varphi^+$. Thus the plus construction is functorial and $\theta$ is natural.

split_report.summary: Split the Stacks Sites 00W5 functoriality lemma into four elementary steps: componentwise transport of compatible H^0 families and refinement compatibility; descent to colimit maps and compatibility with pullback restrictions; naturality of the canonical theta map on the trivial covering; and identity/composition on representatives. The existing definition node supplies the covering, refinement, pullback, colimit, and theta data, so no new reusable node was needed. Mathlib searches remain recorded: its plusMap/toPlus naturality is for sieve-based Grothendieck topologies, while this node uses the Stacks covering-family colimit construction.

lean.statement: theorem plus_construction_functorial {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {F G H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} [∀ (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (X : C) (S : J.Cover X), HasMultiequalizer (S.index P)] [∀ (X : C), HasColimitsOfShape (J.Cover X)ᵒᵖ (Type u)] (φ : F ⟶ G) (ψ : G ⟶ H) : (φ ≫ J.toPlus G = J.toPlus F ≫ J.plusMap φ) ∧ (J.plusMap (𝟙 F) = 𝟙 (J.plusObj F)) ∧ (J.plusMap (φ ≫ ψ) = J.plusMap φ ≫ J.plusMap ψ)
